title: A demand-driven template search pass becomes a pool candidate: register the gate-passed artifact with its proof and baseline so the persona pool cycle can admit it

acceptance_1_reproduction.summary: Prior to this change, a passing template search attempt was only persisted into the demand discovery attempts map and never registered into Registry, Governance, or Alpha Replication stores; meanwhile the persona pool candidate reader required a completed admitted alpha-replication entry plus an approved Registry execution_bundle with a resolved baseline.

template_search_attempt_sink.detail: TemplateDemandSearch._run evaluated the compiled template via evaluate_template_candidate, built receipt={'status': response.admission_status.value, 'gate': response.to_dict(), ...}, stored it in record['attempts'][aid], and called self.store.record_template_search(...). No production code read demand['discovery']['template_search']['attempts'] to register an execution_bundle or create a replication admission.

pool_candidate_reader_requirements.detail: HttpPoolCyclePorts.candidates reads GET /api/research-orchestrator/alpha-replication/entries (line 565), requires row['admission_status']=='admitted' and row['queue_status']=='completed' with no last_error (lines 581-583), fetches GET /api/registry/strategies/{family}/entries (line 585), requires entry['artifact_type']=='execution_bundle' and entry['lineage']['source_strategy_spec_id']==spec_id (lines 607-609), and requires resolve_member_baseline(...)['status']=='approved' (lines 610-614). No producer created the Registry execution_bundle, Governance paper approval, or completed AlphaReplication admission/queue entry from a passing template search attempt.

verified_behavior: Passing attempt binds backtest run owner and gate verdict digest (bind_backtest_run_owner / bind_backtest_run_gate_verdict at services/research/candidate_registration.py:432-433).

Registers candidate strategy artifact via POST /api/registry/strategy-artifacts with producer_run_id, replication_proof, backtest_evaluation, and metadata carrying tenant_id, persona_id, demand_ref, execution_context='paper', capital_scale_pct=0.0 (services/research/candidate_registration.py:483-500).

Proposes, reviews, and decides paper-only low-risk governance approval apv-tpl-* with evidence_refs naming registry_entry and research_demand, then advances the registry entry to artifact_state='approved' and verifies resolve_member_baseline returns status='approved' (services/research/candidate_registration.py:527-668).
Records admitted replication entry and completed queue entry carrying persona_id and demand_ref (services/research/candidate_registration.py:673-688).

Failing attempts never call registrar and direct invocation with a non-admitted receipt raises CandidateRegistrationError('attempt_did_not_pass_gate') without writing to Registry, Governance, or Replication stores.

HttpPoolCyclePorts.candidates filters alpha-replication rows and registry execution_bundle entries by tenant_id/owner_tenant and persona_id, and requires any demand-originated candidate to match the opening persona_id and demand_ref.

PoolAutonomyCycle still evaluates every existing pool policy criterion (sharpe improvement, correlation, effective bets, drawdown/gross risk limits) and opens/verifies the risk officer consultation memo before admitting as a paper trial member.

TemplateDemandSearch persists the gate receipt before registration; on restart or replay after a transient registration failure, already-admitted attempts complete registration before the template loop and are skipped in the evaluation loop so the family trial counter is charged once.

HttpPoolCyclePorts.decide_pool checks prior pool versions for an existing admit decision on the same candidate artifact_ref and returns the recorded version on replay without re-charging persona_trial_count; HttpPoolCyclePorts.candidates excludes any candidate that already has an admit or evolution_trial decision.
When canonical dataset path is missing, records governed_market_data_missing on the demand and fails the run.
When threshold policy path is missing, records governed_policy_authority_missing on the demand and fails the run.
When load_evaluation_authority fails or rejects the dataset/policy, records governed_policy_authority_unavailable:<Error> on the demand and fails the run.
No synthetic market data or fallback strategy artifact is constructed and no trial counter is incremented.

flow_verified: Day 1: PersonaCycleController runs PoolAutonomyCycle, detects effective_bets shortfall, and opens a research demand in ResearchDemandStore.

Day 2: Reconcile triggers _search_demand_templates -> _execute_template_search -> TemplateDemandSearch -> SharedReplicationGate -> TemplateCandidateRegistrar -> RegistryService + RealGovernanceApprovalHarness -> AlphaReplicationAdmissionStore/Queue; HttpPoolCyclePorts.candidates discovers the approved bundle and PoolAutonomyCycle decides admit_trial and opens risk consultation.
Day 3: Risk consultation memo is published and verified; PoolAutonomyCycle applies admit_trial to PersonaStrategyPoolStore with stage='trial', demand_ref, baseline_ref, and persona_trial_count=1.
Day 4: Demand reconciliation observes the trial pool member carrying demand_ref and transitions the research demand to status='satisfied'.
